annotations.label: Sum Lower Bound (Generalized)
annotations.content: The minimum sum of $n$ distinct naturals $\geq c$ is $cn + \binom{n}{2}$. Proved by induction: extract the minimum element $m \geq c$, then the remaining $n-1$ elements are $\geq m+1$.

annotations.label: Triangular Number Lower Bound
annotations.content: Any $n$ distinct non-negative integers sum to at least $\binom{n}{2} = n(n-1)/2$.

annotations.label: Complement Sum Identity
annotations.content: For $A \subseteq \{0, \ldots, N\}$ with $|A| = n$: $nN = \sum_{a \in A}(N-a) + \sum_{a \in A} a$.

annotations.label: Distinct Elements Sum Upper Bound
annotations.content: The **complement argument**: map $a \mapsto N - a$ to get $n$ distinct non-negative integers. Their sum $\geq n(n-1)/2$ forces $\text{sum}(A) \leq nN - n(n-1)/2$.

annotations.label: Improved DSS Lower Bound
annotations.content: **Main result**: $2nN + 2 \geq 2^{n+1} + n(n-1)$. Combining the DSS sum bound $2^n \leq \text{sum}(A) + 1$ with the distinctness upper bound $2 \cdot \text{sum}(A) + n(n-1) \leq 2nN$.
